1) (Currently amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle is intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker and a polymer having anionic sites.

2) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker __selected from zirconium, aluminum, iron, titanium, and chromium__.

3) (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine.

4) (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants.

5) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound __selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate, provided that the polyalkylenimine is less than 1500 Da__.

6) (Original) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions.

8) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex comprised a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about __200 to 900 nm__ in diameter.

9) (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticles are stable in water, field brine and seawater.

10) (Currently amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine __of less than 1500 Da__ and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron __and intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker and a polymer having anionic sites__.

12) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation __selected from Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al, provided that the polyalkylenimine is less than 1500 Da__.

13) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al, __and wherein the polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle is associated with a polymer having anionic sites that can be crosslinked by said multivalent cation__.

21) (Currently amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer __having anionic sites__ that can be crosslinked with a); and c) a fluid.

22) (Cancelled)

23) (Cancelled)

24) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is __selected from polymers or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acrylamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acrylamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, provided that the polyalkylenimine in claim 1 is less than 1500 Da__.

26) (Currently amended) The composition of claim 21, where __said__ fluid is brine or seawater __and the polyalkylenimine is less than 1500 Da__.
